images.subject: A sleek far-future high-tech railgun prototype with a seamless armoured casing and two long parallel electromagnetic rails as its barrel, mounted on a compact pedestal and centred in the frame.
images.detail: Crackling electric arcs run between the rails as it fires a white-hot projectile, which leaves a bright straight trail across the hall and exits the frame on the right.

images.subject: A sleek far-future high-tech heavy twin-barrel autocannon turret with a seamless armoured casing and illuminated light strips, mounted on a compact pedestal and centred in the frame.
images.detail: Both barrels fire at once with a bright muzzle flash, and a stream of glowing white-hot tracer rounds flies across the hall and exits the frame on the right.

images.subject: A sleek far-future high-tech missile launcher prototype: one compact armoured launch pod with a grid of missile tubes, mounted on a pedestal and centred in the frame.
images.detail: One missile has just launched from the pod and streaks away on a white-hot exhaust trail that curves out of the frame on the right.

images.subject: A massive far-future high-tech cannon prototype with one huge thick barrel and a seamless armoured breech, mounted on a heavy pedestal and centred in the frame.
images.detail: It fires: a blinding white-hot muzzle blast bursts from the end of the barrel with a ring-shaped shockwave of hot air around it.
